verdict.line: You lose when you dump Q and W into Shen's Feint (W) and get stunned into nothing, but you win when you poke with E and all-in only after his W and E are both on cooldown.

brief.thesis: Shen's entire laning plan is built around Feint (W) absorbing your short-range engage, so Thundering Smash (Q) and Frenzied Maul (W) thrown at a shielded Shen just burn your cooldowns for free. Volibear's actual damage source in this matchup is Sky Splitter (E), a 1200-range poke that doesn't require you to be in taunt range at all. The 46.6% head-to-head over 1273 games reflects players committing Q/W too early into the shield, not a real power deficit.

theirWindow.when: Shadow Dash (E) and Feint (W) both up
theirWindow.what: He can taunt you from 575 range, then Feint through your stun damage while his minions and Vorpal Blade (Q) life-tap heal him back. Don't commit Q or W here, just hold E range and let the wave trade instead.

yourWindow.when: Shen just used W or whiffed his E
yourWindow.what: His Feint is on a 9-5s cooldown depending on rank and Shadow Dash is 16-8s, so the moment either goes down you have a real engage. Walk in, land Q's stun, double-tap W for the bonus damage and heal, then follow with E for the slow and shield.

powerCurve.note: Shadow Dash taunt punishes any facecheck or overextension
R adds burst but 160s cooldown is punishing
attack speed stacking and on-hit items outscale his kit
R's tower-disable turns splits into tempo wins

start.why: Your kit is mana-hungry with four low-cooldown abilities (W every 5s, E every 16s flat), and this is the 74.8%-pick, 46.6%-winrate start over 1160 games for exactly that reason.

boots.why: 49.7% winrate over 481 games and the tenacity directly cuts Shadow Dash's taunt duration, which is the single CC that ends your lane if you get caught.

core.why: Highest-sample core path at 55.1% over 118 games; the attack speed feeds your passive's bonus magic damage proc for extended trades.
Cooldown reduction on crit stacks with your already-short W/E timers, letting you poke and reset faster than Shen can reset his shield.
Heal amp pairs with your W's self-heal on recast, letting you win extended skirmishes once his shield window is gone.

situational.when: the game is trending toward wave clear and poke-heavy teamfights (63.6% over 33 games as a first item)
you need to out-sustain Shen's Vorpal Blade life-tap in prolonged trades
the enemy team stacks shields or damage mitigation beyond just Shen's Feint
the game goes long and you want raw sustained DPS over burst

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping attack speed rewards sticking to Shen through extended trades, which is exactly when his short Feint window runs out and you start winning the fight.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest winrate (48.2%) and by far the most-picked (70.8%) combo in this matchup, giving you a way to close out the all-in window once Shen's W and E are down before he can trade it back.

playing.title: Never Q/W into Feint
playing.detail: If Shen's W shield is up, your stun and on-hit burst get absorbed for nothing. Hold your engage tools and poke with E instead.

playing.title: Respect Shadow Dash range
playing.detail: His E taunts from 575 range with minor damage attached. Don't stand in a straight line to him past minion cover before level 6.

playing.title: Poke first with Sky Splitter
playing.detail: E's 1200 range lets you chip Shen and force a Feint without ever entering his taunt or Q life-tap range.

playing.title: Double-tap your W on commitment
playing.detail: Once you're in a real trade, recast Frenzied Maul on the same target for the bonus damage and self-heal before he can Feint again.

playing.title: Track his Q sustain near minions
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade life-taps and heals allies who attack the target, so don't let him farm free sustain off cannon waves while you're passive.

playing.title: Save R to end skirmishes or siege
playing.detail: Stormbringer's tower-disable on landing is a split-push tool against Shen's global teleport threat; don't waste it just to close a gap in lane.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the matchup reasoning (shield timing, taunt windows, trade patterns) is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Shen’s taunt. Avoid using your [Q][W] while Shen’s (W) is active. Use [E] to contest lane and wait for a chance.
